I hear you've gotten close to that person lately...?
I heard the rumors.
rows.notes: Nanase, male version of ext_nns_004; ano hito (gender not given), kept neutral.

rows.en:
I hear you've gotten close to that person lately...?
I couldn't help hearing the rumors.
(So this is our Frontier!)
(Amazing... So this is a real sky...)
rows.notes: Shared by both genders in the ending scenes.

rows.en: Glad to see you're in one piece, \p.
Oh, Major Ozma.

Good to see you made it back safe and sound.
Then again, with your skills, I figured you'd be fine.

We took down Grace, who threw Frontier into chaos,
and we made it to a new planet...

But that doesn't mean
our job as S.M.S. is over.

(That's right. Nobody can say for sure
that Frontier will never be dragged
into danger again...)

I've got high hopes for you.
I'm counting on you from here on out,
\p!

Likewise, sir! I look forward to serving with you,
Major Ozma!!

Heh, that came out awfully stiff.
For now, let's just be glad we made it
to this new planet.

(Now that I think about it, me joining S.M.S.
took one crazy coincidence after another...)

(If I hadn't enrolled at Mihoshi...
If I hadn't met Alto and the others...
my life never would have turned out like this.)

(I wonder what's going to happen
on this new planet?)

Yes, from here...
It all starts from here...!
(So this is our Frontier!)

(That's right. Nobody can say for sure
that Frontier will never be dragged
into danger again...)

(Now that I think about it, me joining S.M.S.
took one crazy coincidence after another...)

(If I hadn't enrolled at Mihoshi...
If I hadn't met Saotome-kun and the others...
my life never would have turned out like this.)

(I wonder what's going to happen
on this new planet?)

Yes, from here...
It all starts from here...!

You made it back alive from that battlefield.
Guess that means you've grown up a little.
No, not at all... I just got lucky.

If you ask me, you're still a greenhorn.
I'll keep putting you through the wringer,
so look forward to it.

Yes, sir! Please keep training me,
Major Ozma!!
rows.notes: The player asks Ozma to train them (yoroshiku onegai shimasu).

rows.en: Oh, Captain Gary.

But that doesn't mean
our job in the New U.N. Forces is over.

Likewise, sir! I look forward to serving with you,
Captain Gary!!

(Now that I think about it, me joining
the New U.N. Forces took one crazy
coincidence after another...)

(If I hadn't enrolled at Mihoshi...
If I hadn't met all kinds of people...
my life never would have turned out like this.)

(Now that I think about it, me joining
the New U.N. Forces took one crazy
coincidence after another...)

(If I hadn't enrolled at Mihoshi...
If I hadn't met all kinds of people...
my life never would have turned out like this.)

If you ask me, you're still only half a pilot.
I'll keep putting you through the wringer,
so look forward to it.

Yes, sir! Please keep training me,
Captain Gary!!

(That's right... Nobody can say for sure
that Frontier will never be dragged
into danger again...)
rows.notes: Female, ext_oth_004; same as c02399 with an ellipsis.

rows.en: (We finally made it...)
rows.notes: ext_oth_005/006 epilogue monologue; the following rows are one sentence split across rows.

rows.en: Looking back, my life in the Macross Frontier fleet
went by without any real trouble, but
it feels like it was long, and yet so short...
It's because my days at Mihoshi Academy
rows.notes: Rows c02422-c02427 form one sentence; English word order shifted slightly across the rows.

rows.en: were brimming with my classmates,
rows.notes: afureteita (c02427) moved up here as 'brimming with'.

rows.en: the friends I made,
and so many fun
things happening
all the time...
No, that's not all.
Here on this huge ship,
everything that happened...
Maybe it's because it was all so new and so much fun...
Our journey to find a new planet may be over, but
my journey to find my own future starts here!
it feels like it was long, and yet so short...
No, that's not all.
my journey to find my own future starts here!
was often rough, with lots of things going wrong, but
(The Vajra backing us up, and the two divas...)

(Thanks to the "Super Dimension Cinderella" and
the "Galactic Fairy," we were able to win.)
(And this is...)

(It's thanks to Alto and the others giving it
their all that we were able to reach this planet.)

(Everyone...
Thank you for protecting Frontier!)
(I'll work on myself even harder than now...)

(And someday, I'll do my best to be useful
to Frontier, just like everyone else!)

(A lot happened before
we made it here, but...)

(Thanks to the "Super Dimension Cinderella" and
the "Galactic Fairy," we were able to win.)

(It's thanks to Saotome-kun and the others giving
it their all that we were able to reach this planet.)
(I'll work on myself even harder than now...)

(And someday, I'll do my best to be useful
to Frontier, just like everyone else!)

uncertain: c02383/c02398: 'koko ga boku-tachi no Frontier' kept as '(So this is our Frontier!)' (the new planet as their frontier, playing on the fleet's name).
c02408 etc.: Gary taii rendered 'Captain Gary' (rank, terms.json ranks 'Capt.').

c02418-c02437: the ext_oth_005/006 epilogue is one sentence spread over one-phrase rows; c02420/c02437 (the two endings) both lead into c02421/c02434. In c02422-c02427 the English order is shifted ('afureteita' rendered in c02423 as 'brimming with') so that every row still reads in sequence.
c02407/c02416: 'hai, yoroshiku onegai shimasu' after the trainer's 'I'll keep training you' rendered 'Please keep training me'.
